Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentStore: Store = self,
		payment: CashPayment
	precondition:
		currentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentSale.IsComplete = false and
		currentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=currentSale.Amount
	postcondition:
		let payment: CashPayment in
		payment.oclIsNew() and
		payment.AmountTendered = amount and
		payment.BelongedSale = currentSale and
		currentSale.AssoicatedPayment = payment and
		currentStore.Sales->includes(currentSale) and
		currentSale.IsComplete = true and
		currentSale.Time = now() and
		payment.Balance = amount-currentSale.Amount and
		result = true
}
